cases.content:
「収益化停止されないチャンネルの特徴を教えてください」

その質問してきてる時点で勉強不足！！

厳しいことを言いますが、

「画像50枚以上なら大丈夫ですか？」
「機械音声を使わなければ大丈夫ですか？」
「AI画像はもうダメですか？」
こういう質問をしているうちは本質が見えていません。
YouTubeはそんな単純なものではありません。

動画は、

・企画
・台本
・音声
・画像
・BGM
・編集

など、様々な要素で構成されています。

そしてYouTubeや視聴者は、それらを総合的に見て判断しています！！

だから、
「これをやれば絶対大丈夫」
「これをやったら絶対アウト」
という明確な答えはありません！！

実際、ほぼ同じようなチャンネルでも、
Aチャンネルは収益化継続
Bチャンネルは収益化停止

なんてことが普通に起きます。

これは裁判と同じです。

過去の事例だけで判断されるのではなく、その案件ごとに総合的に判断されます。

YouTubeも同じ。
だから僕たちがやるべきことは、

収益化停止されない裏技を探すことではなく、

視聴者にとって有益で、オリジナル性のある動画を作ること。

結局、生き残るのはクリエイティブなチャンネルです！！

「でもYouTubeの誤りで停止されてるCHもるやん！」
とか例外があるのは認める。

cases.title: A Japanese TV crew filmed a 29 year old man for a feature on AI side hustles. He earned 160 million yen in a year from a Tokyo high rise. He has never made a single video that a human planned, watched
cases.content:
A Japanese TV crew filmed a 29 year old man for a feature on AI side hustles. He earned 160 million yen in a year from a Tokyo high rise. He has never made a single video that a human planned, watched or wanted.

On camera he said the line everyone screenshotted: a six year old can make money with AI now. He pointed at his own shirt. The bunny on it was generated by a child.

His business sounded simple. Build a channel with AI cat videos. Grow it past a million subscribers. The crew assumed the videos were the product. They were not.

Pause at 1:14. Look at the second monitor, the tab behind the editor. It is not YouTube. It is an M&A marketplace. Rows of channels listed for sale. His real job is not making videos. It is manufacturing audiences and selling them by the kilo.

The agent picks a trend, generates the slop, uploads on a schedule, and watches the subscriber count. At 1.4 million it does the one thing he taught it: list the channel for sale and start the next one. He does not edit. He does not post. He approves.

Here is the part nobody read. Scroll the buyer column. The accounts purchasing his channels run the same software he does. He is selling AI audiences to other people's AI. Videos no human made, sold to no human, to be milked by a machine and flipped again.

The 1.4 million subscribers are real people. They are the only humans left in the entire transaction.

He still goes on TV. He still calls it a side hustle. He still says a six year old can do it, and he is right, because nobody in the loop is doing anything a six year old could not.

The crew came to film a man who got rich on AI. They left with a market where machines sell crowds to machines, and the crowd is us.

Tomorrow another channel crosses a million. A listing goes up. And something with no name clicks buy.

cases.content:
A man who has never been born made $180,000 last year selling a $30 product

He has 158,000 people who trust him. They send him fan mail. They recommend him to friends. They quote him in comments

He has no birth certificate. No social security number. No face that has ever been photographed by any camera on earth

He was built in software for $198

and his audience has absolutely no idea

here's the exact system behind it and how to build one from scratch:

he runs a YouTube channel in the homesteading niche. consistent AI character. same face, same voice, same look, every single video. his audience is 45-65 year old americans who watch full videos, stay loyal for years, and actually buy things

ads at his channel size pay $400-800/month. a bag of groceries. that's not the business

the business is a $30 ebook linked in every video description. $30 x 0.5% conversion rate on 100,000 monthly views = $15,000/month. $180,000/year. from a person who does not exist

read that again. a generated character with a $30 product is out-earning doctors, lawyers, and real business owners who spent 10 years building something with their actual name and face on it

step 1: pick the niche on math

your passion is worth $0 in revenue. the audience's age and location is worth everything

target 45-65 year olds in tier 1 countries. they watch start to finish. they subscribe and come back. advertisers pay 3-5x more to reach them

niches that print: military history, retirement planning, homesteading, health after 50, financial history, geopolitics, true crime, ancient civilizations. low competition. high RPM. viewers who sit through 15 minute videos like it's a movie

step 2: steal a proven concept

find an AI character crushing it on Instagram or TikTok that hasn't crossed to YouTube longform yet. or take a US channel that works and rebuild it for the UK or Canada. or find a faceless stock-footage channel and put a consistent face on it. the face adds trust the original never had

(Subscribr pulls outlier videos in your niche, extracts the formats already proven to work, and generates ideas backed by millions of real videos. or do it manually by sorting competitor channels by most popular and finding the outliers)

step 3: build ONE character and never change him

same face. same voice. same outfit. same setting. every single video. recognizable in a single frame

YouTube's classifier is hunting for "inauthentic content" right now. random AI visuals with no consistent identity = content farm = deleted. a consistent character with a recognizable face = real channel = safe. the classifier reads identity, not humanity

(Subscribr generates the avatar with a consistent face and voice and produces the finished video from your script. script in, video out. no camera, no recording, no editing)

step 4: warm up the account 7 days before uploading

skip this and you're dead before you start. YouTube has a hidden trust score. fresh email + instant uploads + zero viewing history = the exact fingerprint of a spam bot. they'll flag you before your first video reaches a single human

use a real email. spend 7 days watching videos in your niche. subscribe to 10-15 channels. leave a few real comments. look human

day 8: upload one video. check impressions after 48 hours. above 500 = alive. below 500 = flagged. start over

step 5: attach the product from day one

ads pay grocery money. the product pays rent. ebook, guide, course, service, community. whatever fits the niche. link it in every description from video one. when trust kicks in, this is the 20x multiplier that turns a side project into a real income

then post 2x a week for 10 videos. read the data. you'll have 1-2 outliers. the algorithm just told you what your channel is supposed to be about. make 5 more of the outlier

total startup: under $200
production per video: under 2 hours
filming: zero
editing: zero
team: zero

a character that has never existed is making more money than most people with a degree, a resume, and 15 years of experience

we currently have a waitlist for the tool that handles the full pipeline. ideation, scripting, avatar, finished video. waitlist link is in bio. spots are limited.
